formats.key: swapExactTokensForTokens(uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOutMin, address[] path, address to, uint256 deadline)
effects: The signer sends exactly amountIn of path[0] from their wallet to the first pair, using their allowance to the router.
The recipient `to` receives at least amountOutMin of path[-1]. The router checks this bound before the swap.
formats.shown: Swap: 'Amount to Send' amountIn in path[0], 'Minimum to Receive' amountOutMin in path[-1], 'Beneficiary' to, and the deadline.

cases.notes: 1 TT01 out and 0.988 TT02 in (>= 0.983 minimum) both match the screen. The Approval event is the allowance spend of the same transfer.

formats.key: swapExactTokensForETH(uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOutMin, address[] path, address to, uint256 deadline)
effects: The signer sends exactly amountIn of path[0] to the first pair, using their allowance to the router.
The router unwraps the WMATIC output and sends native POL, at least amountOutMin, to `to`.
formats.shown: Swap: 'Amount to Send' amountIn in path[0], 'Minimum to Receive' amountOutMin as native POL, 'Beneficiary' to, and the deadline.

cases.notes: 10 TT01 out and 0.01131 POL native in (>= 0.01126) match. The reader wrote 'up to 10 TT01', but the amount was right.

formats.key: addLiquidity(address tokenA, address tokenB, uint256 amountADesired, uint256 amountBDesired, uint256 amountAMin, uint256 amountBMin, address to, uint256 deadline)
effects: The signer sends amountA of tokenA to the pair. amountA is between amountAMin and amountADesired.
The signer sends amountB of tokenB to the pair. amountB is between amountBMin and amountBDesired.
The router creates the pair if it does not exist yet.
The recipient `to` receives LP tokens. The pool decides the amount, and the call has no minimum for it.
formats.shown: Add Liquidity: 'Desired amount' and 'Minimum amount' for tokenA and tokenB, 'Beneficiary' to, and the deadline. The LP tokens received are not mentioned.

findings.title: addLiquidity does not show the LP tokens minted to the beneficiary; the pool decides the amount.
findings.evidence: UniswapV2Router02.sol addLiquidity: `liquidity = IUniswapV2Pair(pair).mint(to);`. Case 7: the signer receives 99.999999999999999 UNI-V2 (signer in), and no field states it. The calldata has no LP amount or minimum.
findings.fix: No field can carry the amount. The intent can say 'Add liquidity, receive LP tokens'.

findings.title: addLiquidity uses the same labels 'Desired amount' and 'Minimum amount' for both tokens, with no direction.
findings.evidence: descriptor addLiquidity: labels 'Desired amount' (amountADesired), 'Minimum amount' (amountAMin), 'Desired amount' (amountBDesired), 'Minimum amount' (amountBMin). Code: the signer sends between the minimum and the desired amount of each token.
findings.fix: Rename the labels to 'Max to deposit (token A)', 'Min to deposit (token A)', and the same for token B.

cases.notes: 100 TT01 and 100 TT02 out match the bounds. The 99.99 UNI-V2 in has no field, and the reader knew LP tokens arrive but not how many.

formats.key: addLiquidityETH(address token, uint256 amountTokenDesired, uint256 amountTokenMin, uint256 amountETHMin, address to, uint256 deadline)
effects: The signer sends amountToken of token to the pair. amountToken is between amountTokenMin and amountTokenDesired.
The signer sends msg.value native POL. The router wraps amountETH (at least amountETHMin) and sends it to the pair.
The router refunds msg.value minus amountETH to the signer.
The recipient `to` receives LP tokens. The pool decides the amount.
formats.shown: Add Liquidity: 'Amount to Send' @.value POL, 'Desired amount' and 'Minimum amount' of the token, 'Minimum amount' POL, 'Beneficiary' to, and the deadline.

findings.title: addLiquidityETH does not show the LP tokens minted to the beneficiary; the pool decides the amount.
findings.evidence: UniswapV2Router02.sol addLiquidityETH: `liquidity = IUniswapV2Pair(pair).mint(to);`. Case 8: the signer receives 6.3245 UNI-V2 (signer in), and no field states it.

findings.title: addLiquidityETH labels @.value 'Amount to Send', but the router refunds unused POL.
findings.evidence: UniswapV2Router02.sol addLiquidityETH: `if (msg.value > amountETH) TransferHelper.safeTransferETH(msg.sender, msg.value - amountETH);`. Descriptor: '@.value' label 'Amount to Send'.
findings.fix: Rename the label to 'Maximum POL to deposit' and amountETHMin to 'Minimum POL to deposit'.

cases.notes: 0.2 POL and 200 TT01 out match. The 6.32 UNI-V2 LP in is not on the screen.

formats.key: removeLiquidity(address tokenA, address tokenB, uint256 liquidity, uint256 amountAMin, uint256 amountBMin, address to, uint256 deadline)
effects: The signer sends `liquidity` LP tokens of the tokenA/tokenB pair to the pair, using their LP allowance to the router. The pair burns them.
The recipient `to` receives at least amountAMin of tokenA.
The recipient `to` receives at least amountBMin of tokenB.
formats.shown: Remove Liquidity: 'Minimum amount' of tokenA and of tokenB, 'Beneficiary' to, and the deadline. The LP amount is not shown.

findings.title: removeLiquidity hides `liquidity`, the LP token amount that leaves the signer's wallet and is burned.
findings.evidence: UniswapV2Router02.sol removeLiquidity: `IUniswapV2Pair(pair).transferFrom(msg.sender, pair, liquidity);`. The descriptor has no field for `liquidity`. Case 9: 37.4166 UNI-V2 leave the signer (signer out), and the screen shows only two minimums.
findings.fix: Add a field {"path":"liquidity","label":"LP tokens to burn","format":"raw"}. The pair address is not in the calldata, so tokenPath cannot resolve the LP token.

cases.notes: The 37.42 UNI-V2 out is not shown, and the reader said the LP amount is unknown. 1.9338 WETH and 724.29 DAI in meet the minimums.

formats.key: removeLiquidityETH(address token, uint256 liquidity, uint256 amountTokenMin, uint256 amountETHMin, address to, uint256 deadline)
effects: The signer sends `liquidity` LP tokens of the token/WMATIC pair to the pair. The pair burns them.
The recipient `to` receives at least amountTokenMin of token, through the router.
The router unwraps WMATIC and sends at least amountETHMin native POL to `to`.
formats.shown: Remove Liquidity: 'Minimum amount' of the token, 'Minimum amount' in POL, 'Beneficiary' to, and the deadline. The LP amount is not shown.

findings.title: removeLiquidityETH hides `liquidity`, the LP token amount the signer gives up.
findings.evidence: UniswapV2Router02.sol removeLiquidityETH calls removeLiquidity(token, WETH, liquidity, ...), which does `transferFrom(msg.sender, pair, liquidity)`. No field for `liquidity`. Case 10: 6.2093 UNI-V2 leave the signer (signer out), and no field states it.
findings.fix: Add a field {"path":"liquidity","label":"LP tokens to burn","format":"raw"}.

cases.notes: The 6.21 UNI-V2 out is not shown. 0.04038 WETH and 970.61 POL native in meet the minimums.

formats.key: removeLiquidityWithPermit(address tokenA, address tokenB, uint256 liquidity, uint256 amountAMin, uint256 amountBMin, address to, uint256 deadline, bool approveMax, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s)
effects: The signer's permit sets the router's LP allowance to `liquidity`, or to unlimited when approveMax is true.
The signer sends `liquidity` LP tokens to the pair. The pair burns them.
The recipient `to` receives at least amountAMin of tokenA and at least amountBMin of tokenB.
When approveMax is true, the router keeps an unlimited LP allowance after the call.
formats.shown: Remove Liquidity: two 'Minimum amount' fields, 'Beneficiary', 'Unlimited LP permit' as raw true/false, and the deadline. The LP amount is not shown.

findings.title: removeLiquidityWithPermit hides `liquidity`, the LP amount permitted, taken and burned.
findings.evidence: UniswapV2Router02.sol removeLiquidityWithPermit: `uint value = approveMax ? uint(-1) : liquidity; IUniswapV2Pair(pair).permit(msg.sender, address(this), value, ...)`, then removeLiquidity burns `liquidity`. Case 11: 0.27534 UNI-V2 approval and transfer out from the signer, and no field states the amount.
findings.fix: Add a field {"path":"liquidity","label":"LP tokens to burn","format":"raw"}.

findings.title: removeLiquidityWithPermit shows approveMax as raw 'true'/'false' and does not say an unlimited allowance stays.
findings.evidence: descriptor: {"path":"approveMax","label":"Unlimited LP permit","format":"raw"}. Code: `uint value = approveMax ? uint(-1) : liquidity;`. Case 11 renders 'Unlimited LP permit: false'.
findings.fix: Use format enum with a map: true -> 'Router keeps unlimited LP allowance', false -> 'Allowance only for this amount'.

cases.notes: LP permit and burn of 0.2753 UNI-V2 (merged with the approval) are not shown with an amount. 0.01 WMATIC and 7.587 TT01 in meet the minimums.

formats.key: removeLiquidityETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(address token, uint256 liquidity, uint256 amountTokenMin, uint256 amountETHMin, address to, uint256 deadline)
effects: The signer sends `liquidity` LP tokens of the token/WMATIC pair to the pair. The pair burns them.
The router forwards its whole token balance to `to`. amountTokenMin is checked before this transfer, so a fee token can deliver less.
The router unwraps WMATIC and sends at least amountETHMin native POL to `to`.
formats.shown: Remove Liquidity: 'Minimum amount' of the token, 'Minimum amount' in POL, 'Beneficiary', and the deadline. The LP amount is not shown.

findings.title: removeLiquidityETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens hides `liquidity`, the LP amount the signer burns.
findings.evidence: UniswapV2Router02.sol removeLiquidityETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens calls removeLiquidity(token, WETH, liquidity, ...), which does `transferFrom(msg.sender, pair, liquidity)`. The descriptor has no `liquidity` field. Case 13 (synthetic) shows only the two minimums.
findings.fix: Add a field {"path":"liquidity","label":"LP tokens to burn","format":"raw"}.

findings.title: removeLiquidityETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens token minimum is checked before the fee transfer to the beneficiary.
findings.evidence: removeLiquidity checks `require(amountA >= amountAMin)` on the pair output to the router. Then `TransferHelper.safeTransfer(token, to, IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this)));` can lose a token fee. Label: 'Minimum amount'.
findings.fix: Rename the label to 'Minimum token amount (before token fees)'.
